rationale.conceptual: The method is an established but non-trivial multi-part workflow: DFT structure relaxation (volume, c/a, atomic positions) followed by dielectric function calculation and conversion to optical spectra. Understanding and correctly implementing these steps requires domain knowledge, but no novel theory is involved, and the agent can use standard open-source codes.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of at least five sequential stages: initial structure setup, geometry optimization (multiple sub-steps), dielectric function computation, and derivation of two separate spectra (absorption and refractive index). Orchestration across two materials and proper data handoffs add moderate engineering complexity.
